teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have been helping people with English online around the world since 2014 (and on italki since 2018) focusing on conversational, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation and reading skills. I have a TEFL certificate (Teaching English to Foreign Learners) and IELTS speaking certificate. 

Learning English should be enjoyable. There may be days when you might feel discouraged or unmotivated, but that should never stop you from achieving your dream.

Important to note - I teach my students with respect and courtesy and appreciate it when they treat me the same.
I believe in teaching you to expand your vocabulary and communicate appropriately in English so please no swearing or dirty words.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Based on what is best for each of my students I use a variety of teaching methods, materials, and personal experience. 
Every person learns differently and is gifted in their own unique ways so whether you are a fast or slow learner if you're determined, you will learn! I'm patient and understanding with my students.
In all of my lessons, there will be grammar and pronunciation corrections - It's okay to make mistakes because that is part of learning, but we don't want to create bad habits.

I like to understand my students' strengths and weaknesses so that I can help you with your language needs. 
The best way to improve your skills is to practice. Practice makes a HUGE difference!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Speaking Practice - Individual Lessons/or 5 / or 10 / Package Available
pro_course_detail.description:
Many people struggle with day-to-day conversations in English due to a lack of practice and confidence. Speaking practice not only improves your skills but also helps you overcome fears and build confidence. Since 2018, I’ve had the privilege of helping students on italki achieve their goals—whether it’s becoming a more confident English speaker, passing a job interview, passing English exams, delivering job presentations, participating in work meetings, traveling abroad, or settling in New Zealand. Whatever your reason, I’m here to help you with your speaking needs and can assure you that consistent practice makes a real difference. During lessons, I focus on correcting grammar and pronunciation in a natural and supportive way.

As for phrasal verbs—they can feel like a real challenge, but there are effective ways to master them. I enjoy teaching phrasal verbs because I understand how frustrating they can be and strive to make the learning process simpler and more enjoyable for my students.

teacher_info.intro: My name is Tulani. My name means, "The one who is calm". I am from South Africa. I love learning about different cultures and am currently in the initial stages of learning 3 languages, namely Portuguese, Kinyarwanda (spoken in Rwanda) and Xitsonga (spoken in South Africa). I have a keen interest in the area of psychology and human behaviour. You can also call me an avid sports fan with a specific interest in basketball which I have played at a semi-professional level.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I worked as an English and History high school teacher for two years before branching off into the field of training. I am a seasoned professional with over 20 years of experience in research methodology training and facilitation across private companies, government institutions, and non-profits, working with professionals from diverse fields. In that training role, I have spent countless hours in front of a whiteboard breaking down complex ideas into easy -to-understand language. I hold a bachelor’s degree in Political Science and Public Administration, along with a 120-hour TEFL certification and have experience in both face-to-face and online teaching.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Leveraging my training experience, I offer tailored conversational English lessons designed for both everyday and formal communication. I offer role-plays tailored to your daily & professional interactions, together with feedback-based fluency coaching which is strengthened by personalised strategies for long-term improvement. My teaching style is interactive and designed around real-world scenarios to help you communicate confidently and effectively across different settings.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak English like a pro
pro_course_detail.description:
Please read carefully: 
a) This course is suitable for students with some prior knowledge of English (B1 + ). 
b) I only accept students over the age of 18. 
c) This course does not follow a curriculum. 
) Lessons will be fully charged if not cancelled or rescheduled with at least 24 hours' notice. 

The aim of this course is to address your English language needs and to teach you in a way that suits you. Additionally, the goal of this class is to help you feel more comfortable and confident speaking English and help you advance to the next level of your English skills. During the conversation class I will help you with your pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve your language skills at work
pro_course_detail.description: Choose this course if you want to express yourself clearly and confidently at work. These lessons will help you navigate formal situations like meetings, presentations, and workplace discussions with ease. You’ll learn practical strategies to communicate effectively, engage in conversations with colleagues, and present your ideas with confidence. Let’s make your English work for you! 🚀

teacher_info.intro:
I'm Vivi & I can totaly understand where you are now. 

I have been there. I have traveled to over 70 countries & met tons of people. Traveling is awesome but it sucks when you could exchange the most amazing & incredible stories & experiences but you get stuck at the basics because of the langauge barrier. 

I lived in Spanish speaking countries and before I started speaking spanish fluently I was just sitting at the table seeming to be under Harry Potter's invisibility cloak & just smiling as the conversation, the gold nuggets & the great info zoomed by me.

It is frustrating and thats why I am here to help you speak fluently & integrate into a culture fully to be part of the story
teacher_info.short_signature: Fun filled German lessons with over 8 years of experience - learn German with ease
teacher_info.introduction: Hey guys I am Vivi from Germany and I speak Spanish, German and Englisch and I am very happy to teach you any of these languages. I love travelling, that’s why I study tourism. I have been to almost 60 countries so I know how it feels like to be in a country as a foreigner, not understanding a single word or struggling with the conversation. I lived in Chile, New Zealand, India, Spain and now I am in Mexico City. During my travels I also learned a lot about different cultures, to do’s and not to do’s . So apart from teaching you a language I find it very important and useful to learn at least a bit about the culture and the behavior of the people as well. I have the experiences of learning languages myself and I also worked as a tutor helping kids and young adults learning a language naturally and preparing for travels or exams. So I also know how to keep people motivated and focused. Due to my travel & teaching experience I also know which kind of mistakes people tend to make and how to avoid them. My classes are very personal & designed to your needs and goals in life. We can work on specific grammar points, vocabulary building, discussions, formal and informal conversation, interview skills, reading, pronunciation, listening and of course on your speaking skills.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I'm an entrepreneur based in Canada & I have been tutoring kids & adults since I am 12. 

I specialize in intermediate & advanced German & English teaching. Fine tuning of grammar, wording, pronunciation & sentence structure. 

Do you desire to speak better German or English? 
Do you need to write better emails, speak to international colleagues or attend meetings in English or German? 
Do you need to communicate & travel in English or German?

Do you want to feel more confident speaking & get exactly what you want by not being misunderstood? 
Do you want to interact more with others on a deeper & more profound level? 

Then schedule a trial lesson.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I take this very serious & even though my lessons are always fun & easy going, I level you up, I push you up the mountain because I want to see you succeed. 

My main focus is improving your confidence & fluency in speaking because all the grammar is useless if you are too afraid to even stand up for yourself & talk. 

Once you schedule a trial lesson, I will determine your oral ability & we will talk about the areas you need to improve. 
We will also discuss how you can use the language in a way that you will enjoy, every single day - as this is the fastest way to improve.

FYI I take my lessons from wherever I am while still ensuring best quality 

I am excited to get to know you!

pro_course_detail.title: Travel Preparation, Planning & Cultural Crash Course
pro_course_detail.description:
Traveling to a new country can always be intimidating but it is the most amazing & rewarding experience in life.
As a travel expert ( having studied international tourism management & having traveled myself to over 65 countries) we can go through your travel plans, optimize the route, talk through fears and worries, and / or go over our packing list. 

We can also talk about the cultural differences, what you need to be aware of, the scams and tricks that might happen, how to prevent them and the countries does and don'ts. 

If you need a crash course to talk spanish or german we can also do that.
